name: tensioner-crank
title: Tensioner: crank pinion and shaft
description: A 17-tooth herringbone pinion, right-handed, on a shaft up past the second stage, its top flatted for the crank arm.

module.rule: Stout teeth for a hand's torque: 5.4 lines across a tooth

helix.rule: Herringbone: no thrust, the gears stay on their shafts and centre themselves

bore.rule: A 4 mm shaft, half a line clear

teeth.rule: The fewest at 20° without a shift

shaft.rule: The crank's shaft, inside the pinion's roots

shaft_top.rule: Up past the second stage and the ratchet

flat.rule: A flat on the shaft's top for the arm to drive

drive_length.rule: The flat's length: the arm's thickness and a little
